propositions: Identical ticket, code, and acceptance criteria produce different verdicts across runs (PASS / FAIL-2 / PASS) within minutes with no intervening changes, making the close gate unreliable.

The verifier's test-existence judgment is non-deterministic because the LLM agent uses variable free-form search strategies (semantic queries, regex patterns) instead of deterministic literal-substring lookups with ticket-id/symbol searches.

The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar lacks diagnosability fields (verified_at_sha, trace_id, input snapshot context) necessary to prove identical input when verdicts flip, conflating genuine flakes with input drift.
False-NEGATIVE verdicts block legitimate completions spuriously (ad9f, 4de6 examples) and waste billable LLM runs; false-POSITIVE verdicts undermine attestation integrity.
Temperature is unpinned in _verify_completion_inner, allowing LLM sampling variance to modulate search strategy selection on borderline criteria.
The completion verifier's prompt does not instruct the agent that search_files is literal case-sensitive substring matching, nor to exhaust ticket-id/symbol searches before concluding test absence.
